# Anti-Rationalization Table

## Core idea

A table inside a skill that lists the excuses an agent will make to skip a step, with a rebuttal written next to each. Writing the excuses down in advance blocks them.

## Examples

Reasoning traces such as "this is too simple to test" or "I tested it manually" are listed in the testing skill, each paired with why the step is still required. Every skill in Addy Osmani's pack has one. The same excuses are familiar from working with junior engineers. See Skill Pack.

## Contradictions
_none_
